title: Remote VM live canary lifecycle and persistence
description: Run the full remote VM path against one deliberately prepared disposable host. This is the release-gate case: it must be run with an operator-supplied ready host and cleaned up through the confirmed delete path.

requires.preparedHost: The remote host must be installed from the matching release, fingerprint-verified, ready, and reserved for this disposable canary
requires.gateway: The authenticated HTTP/WebSocket gateway and remote VM Functions revision are deployed
requires.cleanup: The case must stop the session and delete the workspace through the explicit permanent-delete confirmation; verify the guest disk and host capacity afterward

steps.expected: In the native pi-web-ui terminal, write a sentinel file, install one harmless user-scoped tool, reload the browser, and confirm the file/tool remain available.
Stop the selected remote session, start it again, reconnect through the gateway, and confirm the sentinel file persists.
Exercise one browser disconnect/reconnect, one duplicate start with the same operation ID, and one gateway/SSH interruption; record the resulting pending/error states without retrying blindly.
